# Instanter

> A background triage agent for eviction-defense clinics. It computes Georgia
> dispossessory answer deadlines from the statute, ranks a clinic's queue by
> urgency, rations attorney interrupts to real capacity, and pauses for a
> licensed human before committing any escalation.

Instanter states operative facts for a licensed attorney and never gives legal
advice. Every case record shown in the console is synthetic and labelled as
such; the statute, the court calendar, and every computation are real.

## Check the claim yourself

- [Live recomputation](https://d2ew2t4uldglcr.cloudfront.net/api/stats): recomputes
  every answer deadline in the corpus on each request and reports how many of them
  counting seven days by hand gets wrong. Nothing is cached.
- [Health](https://d2ew2t4uldglcr.cloudfront.net/api/health)
